# emu-alltest sweep forms without a native run (ledger U850-U852), expected values only:
#   emu-alltest --cases Emulator\data\cases_sweep_sdm.txt --expect-only

# Natively WRFSBASE/WRGSBASE and LFS/LGS would replace the host thread's FS/GS (GS base = the
